title: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 이북5도 및 미수복 시ㆍ군의 명예시장ㆍ군수 등 위촉에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 3 (Term of Office)
(1) The term of office of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun shall be three years, and the person may be reappointed only once: Provided, That this restriction shall not apply where two or more reappointments are unavoidable due to special regional circumstances or similar reasons.
(2) Notwithstanding the main clause of paragraph (1), the term of office of an honorary Mayor or head of Gun newly commissioned to fill a vacancy shall be the remainder of the predecessor's term.
